statement: The reflectometer is unreliable for thicknesses of the order of 10 nm, so the ending profiles of the line scans are not accurate.
The temperature trends of the penetration depth are reported without a mechanism; the authors call for a dedicated study.
The Fig. 4 depths come from interference colours read by eye (blue for 100 nm, brown for 50 nm), not from a thickness measurement.
The gap-height comparison of Fig. 5(b) is an initial result from three chips; the remaining gap heights 0, 300 and 800 nm are the target thickness subtracted twice from the original height.
The nine Fig. 3 films share the recipe's typical pulsing and a 50 nm target; their cycle numbers are not stated.
The Fig. 1 dimension table (lateral lengths, opening widths, maximum aspect ratios per cavity height) is an image whose cells were not read; the stated ranges stand in for it.
